# Technical Requirements: Crypto Hunt

## Stack

| Layer | Choice |
|---|---|
| Framework | Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, TypeScript strict |
| Styling | Tailwind CSS 4, CSS tokens from [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md) |
| 3D / motion | three, @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei, @react-three/postprocessing, motion |
| Backend | Supabase: Postgres, Auth, Realtime, Storage, Edge Functions (Deno) |
| QR | `qrcode` (generate), `@zxing/browser` (scan; loaded only when the camera opens). A printed QR encodes `<site>/q/<token>`; the in-site scanner reads the token from it |
| Fonts | IM Fell English SC, Spectral, IBM Plex Mono shipped in `src/fonts` (SIL OFL) via `next/font/local`, so builds never depend on Google Fonts |
| Validation | zod |
| Tests | Vitest, @testing-library/react, jsdom; integration via supabase-js on the test project; Playwright for print preview |
| Hosting | Vercel |

## Architecture

See [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md).

## APIs

### Postgres RPCs (called via `supabase.rpc`)

**Player.** Guard failures **raise** (`NOT_AUTHENTICATED`, `NOT_REGISTERED`, `SESSION_MOVED`). Game outcomes **return** `{ok: false, code}` so the alerts and rate-limit counters they write are kept. Codes are UPPER_SNAKE.

| RPC | Args | Returns | Errors |
|---|---|---|---|
| `join_preflight` / `join_commit` | name, team_code (+ ip / user_id) | service role only (player-join) | BAD_NAME, BAD_CODE, TEAM_FULL, TEAM_LOCKED, REGISTRATION_CLOSED, RATE_LIMITED, NAME_TAKEN (only if another account holds that name) |
| `claim_session` | nonce | ok | BAD_CLAIM |
| `team_preview` | code, ip | service role only (player-join `preview: true`): crew name, number, status, member initials | BAD_CODE, RATE_LIMITED |
| `my_status` | — | player, team (incl. its own code), round, phase, my task (no answer; category, difficulty, piece index), pieces (holder name, mine, hint used), members, penalty, broadcast, region, `seal_code` (own team, final round, all 4 pieces solved only) | NOT_REGISTERED, SESSION_MOVED |
| `scan_qr` | token | see [Scan resolution](SYSTEM_WORKFLOW.md#scan-resolution); `ASK_KEY` / `ASK_KEY_AND_SEAL` create a scan ticket | BAD_QR, NOT_YOURS, LOCKED_MARK, ALREADY_DONE, SOLVE_FIRST, PAUSED, ELIMINATED |
| `submit_answer` | task_id, answer (multiple choice: the shown letter index 0–3) | {correct, pieces} or, when wrong, {correct: false, replaced (multiple choice), strikes, penalized, penalty_ms} (D-041) | NOT_YOUR_TASK, ALREADY_SOLVED, BAD_ANSWER, RATE_LIMITED, PAUSED |
| `use_hint` | task_id | {hint, penalty_ms} | HINTS_OFF, ALREADY_USED |
| `submit_key` | token, key, seal_code (final only) | {checked_in, team_count} | NOT_SCANNED, LOCKED_MARK, BAD_KEY, BAD_SEAL, RATE_LIMITED |
| `complete_round` | — | {completed, next_round?, rank?} | PENALTY_RUNNING, NOT_READY |
| `report_focus_event` | task_id, kind, away_ms | {received} | — |
| `set_eliminated_view` | view | — | NOT_ELIMINATED |

**Admin** (all check `is_admin()`; mutating overrides require `reason`)

Admin RPCs **raise** on failure (nothing half-applies). `admin_snapshot()` (the live dashboard in one read: game, rounds, crews with progress and members, open alerts with the place behind each mark, ship's log, course and question counts; migration 0013), `ack_all_alerts()`, `create_teams`, `rename_team`, `delete_team`, `set_registration`, `apply_game_plan(plan jsonb)`, `start_game`, `pause_game`, `resume_game`, `broadcast`, `set_hints`, `set_advance_count`, `end_game`, `move_team`, `set_member_inactive`, `repoint_team`, `kick_player`, `disqualify_team`, `force_complete`, `ack_alert`, `export_results`, `start_new_game(confirm, regenerate_qr)`.

### Edge Function

`player-join` — POST `{name, team_code}` → `join_preflight` (rate limit 60/min per IP, name, code, capacity) → creates (or, for the same name in the team, reuses) a pre-confirmed auth user (synthetic email `<uuid>@players.cryptohunt.app`, random password nobody ever sees) → `join_commit` (team row locked, 4-member cap, 4th locks the team) → returns a one-time login `token_hash` (magic link, no email sent) and a `claim_nonce`. The phone calls `auth.verifyOtp({token_hash, type: 'magiclink'})`, then `claim_session(nonce)`, which binds the player to that session (`players.session_id`). Any other phone of that player then gets `SESSION_MOVED` (T11; the admin gets a `session_moved` alert). `verify_jwt = false`: the function validates its own input.

### HTTP routes

| Route | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `/q/[token]` | Landing for normal camera apps: "Open Crypto Hunt to scan this". No side effects; token removed from the URL |
| `/admin/login` | Admin name + passcode. Every other `/admin` page is guarded server-side (signed out → login; not in `admins` → login with a notice) |
| `/admin`, `/admin/generator`, `/admin/locations`, `/admin/crews`, `/admin/questions`, `/admin/log` | Admin console (P4) |
| `/admin/print?sheet=qr\|master\|codes` | Print views (admin only): QR cards 2 per A4 with a cut-off placement stub (D-031), the master list with every key, crew code slips |

## Database

| Table | Key columns | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `admins` | `user_id` pk, `name` | Defines `is_admin()` |
| `games` | `id=1`, `status`, `registration_open`, `hints_enabled`, `paused_at`, `broadcast`, `hint_penalty_ms` (60000), `wrong_penalty_ms` (60000, D-041) | One row |
| `teams` | `id`, `name`, `code` unique, `status`, `eliminated_in_round`, `final_rank`, `completion_key`, `eliminated_view`, `final_code` (null until the final clue is solved) | `final_code` unique; never in `public_state` |
| `players` | `id`, `team_id`, `user_id`, `name`, `is_active`, `session_id`, `created_at` | unique `(team_id, lower(name))`; max 4 per team (trigger) |
| `locations` | `id`, `name`, `place_no` (unique), `building`, `floor`, `landmark`, `area` (route area, D-042), `notes` (hiding spot), `map_x`, `map_y`, `reveal_radius` | Kept across games; place details print on the card stub (D-043) |
| `clue_sets` | `location_id`, `set_no` (1–3), `pieces text[4]`, `hint` | Admin only; `assignments.clue_set` is drawn per crew by trigger (T-507) |
| `venue_map` | `id=1`, `image_path`, `width`, `height` | Image in Storage bucket `venue` (public read, admin-only write, PNG/JPG/WebP ≤ 10 MB). Pins are 0–1 across the image; `reveal_radius` is a fraction of the image width |
| `rounds` | `id`, `number`, `qr_count`, `advance_count`, `difficulty`, `is_final`, `closed_at` | |
| `qr_codes` | `id`, `round_id` null, `kind` (universal, target, spare, prank, final), `location_id`, `token` (24 random bytes, base64url) unique, `key` (6 chars, no look-alikes), `label` | Players have no select policy |
| `qr_links` | `from_qr`, `to_qr` | Pyramid edges |
| `assignments` | `team_id`, `round_id`, `qr_id` | unique `(team_id, round_id)` |
| `team_state` | `team_id` pk, `round_number`, `phase`, `penalty_ms`, `penalty_until`, `round_started_at` | Realtime to own team |
| `round_results` | `team_id`, `round_id`, `completed_at`, `completion_order` | unique `(round_id, completion_order)` |
| `tasks` | `id`, `team_id`, `player_id`, `round`, `question_id`, `piece_index`, `opened_at`, `solved_at`, `hint_used`, `wrong_count`, `option_order` (per-player shuffle), `replaced_questions`, `strikes` (misses since the last penalty) | Multiple choice: D-029; penalties: D-041 |
| `scan_tickets` | `player_id`, `qr_id`, `round_id`, `issued_at`, `expires_at` (+10 min) | Issued only by `scan_qr` for the team's own current-round QR; required by `submit_key`; deleted on round change (D-025) |
| `checkins` | `player_id`, `round_id`, `qr_id`, `scanned_at`, `key_ok_at`, `seal_ok_at` (final only) | unique `(player_id, round_id)` |
| `questions` | `id`, `text`, `format`, `options jsonb`, `answer`, `alternatives text[]`, `hint`, `difficulty`, `category`, `is_enabled` | Players have no select policy |
| `events` | `id`, `team_id`, `player_id`, `kind`, `data jsonb`, `at` | Timeline; insert-only |
| `alerts` | `id`, `team_id`, `player_id`, `kind`, `data`, `acknowledged`, `at` | |
| `admin_audit` | `id`, `admin_id`, `action`, `target`, `reason`, `at` | Insert-only |
| `rate_limits` | `player_id`, `bucket`, `window_start`, `count` | |
| `public_state` | `id=1`, `data jsonb`, `event_seq` | Leaderboard + map ships; names only |

- **Answer matching:** MCQ by option index; text: `lower(unaccent(regexp_replace(trim(x), '\s+', ' ', 'g')))` against answer + alternatives; numbers compared numerically.
- **Indexes:** `qr_codes(token)`, `tasks(team_id, round_id)`, `round_results(round_id)`, `events(at desc)`.

## Integrations

None at runtime besides Supabase and Vercel. Blender (MCP) at build time only.

## AI/LLM system

None (D-018).

## Runtime

- Player bundle: gameplay routes < 250 KB JS gzipped excluding three.js; three.js and GLBs load only on the finale and transitions (dynamic import).
- GLBs < 1.5 MB each with baked WebP textures.
- p95 RPC < 500 ms with 120 players.

## Deployment

- `supabase db push` + `supabase functions deploy player-join` to test, then prod (`supabase link --project-ref <ref>` first).
- Admin account: `npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/create-admin.mts --name … --passcode … [--target prod]` (prod needs `PROD_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` inline, never stored).
- Function privileges are explicit (migration 0007): nothing is executable by `anon`; `authenticated` gets exactly the player + admin API; `service_role` only the two join functions. Every new RPC needs its own `grant`.
- Vercel: preview per branch, production from `main`.
- Supabase Auth: raise the per-IP sign-in limit for event WiFi (see RELEASE_CHECKLIST).

## Environment variables

| Name | Where | Secret |
|---|---|---|
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` | Vercel, local | no |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` | Vercel, local | no (public) |
| `TEST_SUPABASE_URL`, `TEST_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`, `TEST_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` | local only (tests, simulation) | service role yes |
| Service role (prod) | Supabase Edge Function only (auto-injected) | yes — never in Vercel |

As in AI Musical Chair minus `@google/genai`, `mammoth`, `papaparse` stays (CSV import). No new runtime dependencies without a decision record.
